'''2011 German National Championship Ralf Wachowiak DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ralf Wachowiak]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage|V11-D-astunningmove.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Who the #### is the Count?
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
